content:
Aisha (CS): Quick sync — KiteMed enablement: planning two 45-min hands-on office hours to walk through model serving & deploy checklist. Need to lock schedule for next week to cover EMEA / US / APAC. Proposed slots:
- Mon 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET
- Tue 15:00 PT / 23:00 CET (late EMEA)
- Wed 02:00 PT / 10:00 SGT (APAC-friendly)
Calendar poll: https://cal.com/kitemed-enable
Agenda draft:
```
- 5m intro & goals
- 15m deploy checklist demo (Carlos)
- 20m hands-on lab: deploy a tiny model to Redwood Dedicated
- 5m feedback + next steps
```
Can we confirm: 1) attendees (eng vs PM vs infra), 2) SE lead (Carlos?), 3) prework (repo access + creds)? @Jon P @Priya R

Jon P: I can do Mon & Tue. Attendees are: 4 engineers + 1 PM. SRE asked for a 10m canary walkthrough after deploy — can we squeeze that in? Also need recording enabled.

Priya R: Rotate slots across timezones? We could run EMEA-friendly this week then APAC-focused next week. I'll create a short prep doc with required access and a checklist.

Carlos M: Happy to lead the demo. I will prepare a step-by-step guide and a minimal Dockerfile snippet. Do we want to show quantized model path as an optional path?

Aisha (CS): Yes — include quantized path as an "extras" slide if time. Good call on the canary, Jon — let's add 10m after demo and shorten hands-on to 15m if needed.

enablement-bot: Event created: KiteMed Enablement — Hands-on Office Hour — Wed 2026-04-15 09:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/j/123456789 (auto-created) :calendar:

Jon P: Zoom + recording is fine. I'll own the canary 10m and the post-session notes. Prep doc link: https://notion.so/kitemed-prep (I added the infra checklist)

Priya R: :thumbsup: I'll build the 3-question feedback form and share it in channel a day before.

Aisha (CS): Thanks everyone. Action items: 1) pick final slot (Aisha) 2) prep doc (Priya) 3) demo slides + snippets (Carlos) 4) recording + canary (Jon) 5) survey (Priya). Will post the calendar invite once slot confirmed and add the attendee list. After session we'll send the feedback + follow-up ticket for any renewal/enablement blockers.

Carlos M: Added initial demo commands to the prep doc. Will ping if I need test creds.

Jon P: If KiteMed wants a separate deep-dive for infra, we should schedule a follow-up 60m next month.

Aisha (CS): Noted — will propose follow-up cadence in the invite. Thanks all :wave:
